slice: Lead integration of the H4e isolated lifecycle probe into Runtime and the diagnostic tool surface
purpose: Wire the owner-only zero-model isolated inner-lifecycle probe: construct its command in init, dispatch it before any GET path with session.probe admission, expose diagnostics.innerLifecycleProbe and register the parameterless shiyu_diagnose_inner_lifecycle tool. The probe builds its own private :memory: ControlStore and never receives live paths.
